styles.prompt: Create a production hair sprite sheet using the attached gray hairstyle as design reference. Exactly THREE separate sprites on one wide canvas in ONE ROW: left FRONT matching reference hairstyle, middle EAST right-facing profile, right NORTH back of head. Same SHORT WOLF CUT hairstyle in every view, consistent crown volume, crescent ahoge, compact feathered layered locks and pointed sideburns. Only HAIR, NO skin, head, ears, face, mannequin, eyes, neck or clothes. Front and side have open negative space where face and ear would be. Grayscale hair with thick BLACK closed outer boundary and elegant silver broad strand highlights, match reference painterly anime RimWorld style. ALL background and negative-space holes MUST BE FLAT SOLID PURE BRIGHT GREEN #00FF00, with NO texture, grid, checkerboard, paper, shadow or gradient. Do not render transparency; use the flat green color. The actual HAIR contains NO GREEN. Each sprite centered in its own equally sized square cell, same skull width and crown height, fully visible with margins. No labels, no text, no borders. Side profile hair must cover back of skull on LEFT and leave face region open on RIGHT, not a front three-quarter view. Rear has closed hair cap, no face opening.

Production hairstyle sprite sheet for RimWorld Ningsha race. Use attached hairstyle as the exact design reference: asymmetric swept bangs, medium hair with ONE chunky loose SIDE BRAID on character's LEFT (viewer right in front), a plain gray tie, tapered end below chin; opposite side has short outward wisps. Exactly THREE separate hair-only views in a single horizontal row: FRONT, EAST facing right in strict profile, NORTH showing back. Same haircut, braid attachment, volume and length in all views. Braided left side is visible in east profile (character left facing camera); in back view the braid is on viewer left. No skin, head, ears, face, body, mannequin or clothes. Front/side face opening empty. All hair grayscale neutral silver-gray with thick closed black outline and broad stylized soft highlights matching reference. FLAT SOLID PURE GREEN #00FF00 backdrop over the entire canvas and inside all face openings/gaps. No checkerboard, no texture or fabric, no shadows or gradients in the background. Three fully separated complete sprites with margins in equal square cells; consistent cranium size and alignment. No titles, labels or text. Rear view must be a closed back-of-head hair cap, no face cutout. This is a production sheet for chroma-key extraction.

Create a production sprite sheet of the ONE HIGH PONYTAIL hairstyle in reference. Exactly THREE hair-only views in one horizontal row: FRONT, EAST strict profile facing RIGHT, BACK. Same ponytail: gathered high at upper rear skull, generous swept curved tail with pointed soft locks, asymmetrical parted bangs and two slim chin-length front locks. Match the reference's gray/silver anime hair, chunky black silhouette outlines and smooth broad highlights. Keep ponytail silhouette clearly different from a loose short haircut. In side profile the gathered tail projects to LEFT behind skull; the face opening is on RIGHT. Back view shows gathered roots flowing into ponytail, no face hole. No head, skin, ears, eyes, face, body, clothes, mannequin or ornaments. Hair itself entirely neutral grayscale, simple gray tie. Background MUST be perfectly flat solid #00FF00 bright green, including all negative-space holes, no transparency preview, no checkerboard or fabric, no shadow, no gradients on green. 3 equal square cells, fully separated complete sprites with ample margins, same cranium proportions and crown alignment. No text, labels or borders. Final production art intended for chroma key extraction.
